Same-batch sibling objectui#10167 is `apps/console/` — disjoint.

### Why `Clause-②: yes`, declared before the route is chosen

⛔ Not because the repair widens anything on purpose — it **narrows**: it stops a save that today succeeds. The `yes` is for the shape the fix most likely takes. `@object-ui/plugin-form` is a published package, and the natural wiring gives its record-form components a way to receive and surface the in-flight signal. A new published prop on `ObjectForm` / `ModalForm` / `DrawerForm` / `EmbeddableForm`, or a new exported label key, is an addition to the published face. ⭐ Per 「拿不准 ⇒ 按 `yes`」, and because a `no` cannot be revised on delivery, this is declared `yes` now with the reason attached so the in-seat review is ⛔ not re-deriving it.

### Premise re-taken by this seat on today's `origin/main` (⛔ not relayed)

Both the filing seat and triage marked this card 「⛔ Relayed, ⛔ not re-derived」 and named the one-consumer count as the load-bearing reading. Re-taken here, `origin/main` `98178b2`, 2026-09-20T23:23Z, with `git grep -nw`:

| reading | value |
|:--|:--|
| hosts that PASS `onUploadingChange` (non-test, non-CHANGELOG) | **exactly 1** — `packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.tsx:445` |
| the signal's own machinery | `packages/fields/src/widgets/` — `useUploadingSignal.ts`, `FileField.tsx:154`, `ImageField.tsx`, `toHostProps.ts`, `types.ts`, `FieldEditWidget.tsx:280` |
| occurrences of `uploading` (case-insensitive, whole word) anywhere in `packages/plugin-form/**` | ⭐ **0 files** |

⇒ the card's mechanism **holds**, and the third row is the sharper statement of it: the record-form package does not merely fail to read the signal, it has ⛔ **no notion of upload state at all**.

⚠️ **One correction to the card's wording, and it changes where you look.** The card and the triage grade both say 「the `@object-ui/plugin-form` record-form chain」. That is right about the defect and may be wrong about the repair site: the signal is produced in `packages/fields` and consumed in `packages/app-shell`, and `plugin-form` is absent from both ends. ⇒ **locating the chain that actually owns the record form's Save is step 1**, and if it turns out to live outside `packages/plugin-form`, that is a finding to report, ⛔ not a breach to hide.

## ✅ Landed and closed — including the contract review and one dequeue that was **not** this PR's

`domain:ui` seat #1, `session_01Xr7APep6jm1Zta3KUzPzZf`, 2026-09-21T03:16Z. PR objectui#10172 merged through the queue; squash **`e686f4d9a`**. 24 files, `+1113/-56`. The PR carried `Fixes`, so the platform closed this card — ⛔ the close is not the evidence; the table is.

Verified by CONTENT with a control taken on the pre-merge base `0d379f571`, ⛔ not by sha and ⛔ not by an ancestor test:

| probe | pre-merge `0d379f571` | merged `e686f4d9a` |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `packages/plugin-form/src/uploadGate.tsx` exists | **0** | **1** |
| `packages/fields/src/widgets/uploadingScope.tsx` exists | **0** | **1** |
| `useUploadGate(` call sites in `plugin-form/src/*.tsx` | **0** | **8** |
| `UploadGateProvider` in `plugin-form/src/*.tsx` | **0** | **23** |
| `UploadingScopeProvider` in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` | **0** | **2** |

Eight `useUploadGate(` sites = the definition plus the **seven** form containers (`ObjectForm`, `DrawerForm`, `ModalForm`, `SplitForm`, `TabbedForm`, `WizardForm`, `MasterDetailForm`), which is the whole family — the point of the card was that a gate on one container is a gate on none.

### What landed

Save is refused, disabled and **explained** while a file or image widget below is still uploading. Every upload widget reports into one scope however deep it sits — a section, a tab, a subform row — and the keyboard-submit path is refused with the same sentence the footer notice shows, so the affordance and the refusal cannot disagree. Ten locale packs carry the new string.

### ⭐ The contract review, and the one thing it changed

`Clause-②` carriers were hung on both sides and cleared only on an **at-tier** review (comment `5754473349`, adopted at `5754481268`): **PASS**, 「237 of 237 requests stamped at the tier constant, zero fallbacks」. ⚠️ Worth remembering: the FIRST attempt at that review died on an HTTP 429 quota before reading a line, and the charter's quota downgrade covers **dispatch, not review** ⇒ the PR stayed draft and the carriers stayed on rather than the gate being waved through. 「一道跑不起来的闸不是一道通过的闸.」

### ⚠️ The dequeue, and why it did not move this head

`Test (shard 6/8)` went red on the first queue branch and dequeued this PR at 02:47:59Z, on `fieldSecurityPayload.test.tsx`'s `DrawerForm` row. Measured as **not this diff's**: the merge commit's `packages/plugin-form`, `packages/fields` and `packages/i18n` trees were **byte-identical** to this head (`0 lines` of diff; CONTROL: 19 files differ over the whole tree), the blobs matched, and this head had been **8 of 8 shards green**. Locally the file ran 6 of 6 green and the whole 107-file package green.

⇒ one re-queue, no push, and it merged. ⛔ The head never moved, so the at-tier review on record still describes the bytes that landed. The order-dependent pin behind it is filed as **objectui#10190** with the mechanism and the competing reading; the full triage is comment `5754824866` on the PR.

### Handed forward

- **objectui#10179** — `submitDisabled` belongs to `@object-ui/components`; folded there, ⛔ not widened into this PR.
- **objectui#10180** — leaving a WizardForm step while an upload is in flight loses the attachment outright; `Next`, not `Save`, is the act that drops it, and this card deliberately does not cover it.
- A docs follow-up for the names this PR published, filed separately — docs-only, and deliberately **after** landing rather than as a push onto a head carrying a contract review.
